text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower confesses that she's terrified 
of letting down the fans' expectations in 
this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the past, she would have done nothing 
but tremble... but she's different now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering the smiles and cheers she had 
received from the fans, she takes on the 
race full of confidence.
